absolute_tolerances.basis: plant-contract.md r5a section 9: every recorded channel compared at 1e-9 relative or 1e-9 absolute per unit of the channel, whichever is looser (Round 1's clause, restored after the Nb3Sn seam refused at gate 8); the offer policy sizes this margin at allowance, where a relative test alone measures the package's root tolerance or rounding, not disagreement
